en.headline: Margarita Mile cocktail trail returns across ten Hong Kong bars from today
en.dek: The two-week event runs until 16 September; participants collect stamps for El Tequileño margaritas, with a grand prize of a trip for two to Tequila, Mexico.

zh.headline: Margarita Mile雞尾酒巡禮今日起於十間酒吧舉行
zh.dek: 活動由今日至9月16日，集齊印章有機會贏取雙人墨西哥Tequila之旅，包括機票及酒莊參觀。

en.headline: Six bids received for inaugural land tender at Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and…
en.dek: Loop Hong Kong Park Company said the response for four parcels totalling more than 76,000 square metres of gross floor area exceeded expectations after the tender closed on Monday.

zh.headline: 港深創新及科技園首批地皮招標接獲六份標書
zh.dek: 落馬洲河套港方園區營運商表示，四幅合共樓面逾7.6萬平方米的地皮周一截標，反應較預期理想。

en.headline: Court of Appeal dismisses government bid to revive Fanling golf course housing plan
en.dek: Judges upheld a 2024 ruling that quashed environmental approval for 12,000 public flats on 9.5 hectares of the resumed site, citing unfair consultation and improper conditions.

zh.headline: 上訴庭駁回政府粉嶺高球場公屋計劃上訴
zh.dek: 三名法官維持2024年原審裁決，撤銷環評批准，指公眾諮詢不公及附加條件超出法定權限，涉及約12,000個公屋單位。

en.headline: Shein shares begin trading on Hong Kong exchange after $1.74 billion IPO
en.dek: The fast-fashion retailer priced 280 million shares at HK$48.56 each, valuing the company at about US$26.5 billion; public offering was 5.63 times subscribed.

zh.headline: Shein股份今日於港交所掛牌 集資約174億港元
zh.dek: 快時尚零售商以每股48.56港元發售2.8億股，集資約136億港元，估值約265億美元；公開發售超額認購5.63倍。

en.headline: Customs warns against XPower wireless power bank over burn risk
en.dek: Tests found the M10C+ model can overheat above 85 degrees Celsius when metal objects are placed between the charger and a device; 220 units were seized and sales banned.

zh.headline: 海關籲停用XPower無線尿袋 測出過熱燒傷風險
zh.dek: 測試顯示該款M10C+充電器在金屬外物夾於中間時溫度可達86.6至131.4度，超過限值；已檢獲220件並禁售。

en.headline: Tram service suspended between North Point and Happy Valley after power fault
en.dek: Westbound services from North Point Terminus to Tin Lok Lane were halted from about 6pm; eastbound services later resumed while engineers worked on the fault.

zh.headline: 北角至天樂里西行電車因電力故障暫停服務
zh.dek: 傍晚約6時起北角總站至天樂里（跑馬地圈）西行線電車暫停，東行線其後恢復，工程人員搶修。

en.headline: Wang Fuk Court buyout acceptance reaches 99.1 per cent as deadline ends
en.dek: By the 5pm Monday cut-off, 1,967 of 1,984 owners had returned acceptance letters, leaving 17 households; the government said it would press ahead with remaining acquisitions.

zh.headline: 宏福苑收購接受率達99.1% 限期屆滿尚餘17戶
zh.dek: 截至周一傍晚5時截止，1,984戶中有1,967戶交回接受書，比率99.1%；餘下17戶或面對強制收地。

en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 issued as Saudel becomes tropical depression
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the signal at 6.10pm after the remnant of the former typhoon intensified; it is expected to stay in force until at least noon on Tuesday.

zh.headline: 沙德爾增強為熱帶低氣壓 天文台發出一號戒備信號
zh.dek: 天文台傍晚6時10分因沙德爾殘餘增強為熱帶低氣壓而發出一號戒備信號，預料信號至少維持至周二中午。

en.headline: Grave of late actress Linda Lin Dai vandalised at Happy Valley cemetery
en.dek: Cemetery staff found graffiti and cement covering the marble altar of the four-time Asia Pacific Film Festival best actress; an 87-year-old man was arrested in connection with damage to a nearby grave.

zh.headline: 跑馬地林黛墳墓遭塗鴉及英泥覆蓋 87歲翁涉破壞鄰近墳墓被捕
zh.dek: 聖彌額爾天主教墳場發現四屆亞太影展影后林黛墓碑遭塗鴉，雲石拜台被英泥覆蓋；警方另就鄰近修會墳墓破壞拘捕一名退休男子。

en.headline: Hong Kong’s first fully autonomous robot retail stores open Tuesday
en.dek: Mainland firm Galbot launches three Galbot Store outlets at Hung Hom waterfront, Wan Chai waterfront and Kai Tak Sports Park, with Financial Secretary Paul Chan completing the first transaction at Kai Tak.

zh.headline: 本港首批全自主機械人零售店周二起營運
zh.dek: 內地具身智能企業銀河通用於紅磡海濱、灣仔海濱及啟德體育園開設三間Galbot Store，財政司司長陳茂波在啟德店完成首宗交易。

en.headline: ICAC, police and Competition Commission arrest 50 over building maintenance bid-rigging
en.dek: A joint operation codenamed Iron Alliance last week targeted a contractor-led syndicate linked to 27 estates and buildings, with contracts valued at nearly HK$500 million.

zh.headline: 廉署警方競委會聯手拘50人 打擊樓宇維修圍標集團
zh.dek: 代號「鐵盟」行動上週打擊以一間工程承辦商為首的貪污圍標集團，涉27個屋苑及大廈，合約總值近5億元。

en.headline: Two trucks collide on San Tin Highway; driver trapped briefly
en.dek: A 5.5-tonne lorry hit the rear of a 10-tonne lorry near Fairview Park shortly after 11am, leaving one driver with a trapped foot and another passenger with abrasions.

zh.headline: 新田公路兩貨車相撞 司機腳部被困一度救出
zh.dek: 上午11時22分近錦綉花園，一輛5.5噸貨車追撞前方10噸貨車，司機腳部被困，另一乘客擦傷，分別送院。

en.headline: Seasonal flu vaccination programmes start on 17 September
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said about 1.3 million doses have been procured for the 2026/27 programmes, with school outreach, residential care and subsidy schemes opening mid-month.

zh.headline: 2026/27季節性流感疫苗接種計劃9月17日展開
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心公布計劃包括學校外展、院舍及疫苗資助計劃，已採購約130萬劑疫苗，呼籲市民盡早接種。

en.headline: Observatory issues Amber Rainstorm Warning; thunderstorms until 3pm
en.dek: Heavy rain exceeding 30 mm an hour is expected to continue generally over Hong Kong after the signal was issued at 12.25pm, with the Thunderstorm Warning extended until 3pm.

zh.headline: 天文台發黃色暴雨警告 雷暴警告延至下午3時
zh.dek: 天文台下午12時25分發出黃色暴雨警告，預料廣泛地區每小時雨量超過30毫米；雷暴警告則延長至下午3時。

en.headline: Lawmaker urges source checks as dog abandonments rise
en.dek: Agriculture-sector legislator Chan Pok-chi said smugglers coach buyers to dodge quarantine, while a welfare group said intakes at one shelter rose at least 50 per cent.

zh.headline: 議員倡追截走私狗源頭 團體稱棄養個案升至少五成
zh.dek: 漁農界議員陳博智指有商人教買家規避檢疫；動物福利關注聯盟成員劉鎮海稱所屬機構近月接收棄養數字按月升至少五成。

en.headline: Transport Department warns of busier roads on first school day
en.dek: Rail, bus, ferry and taxi operators have been told to add services on Tuesday if needed, while the department's emergency centre will run at its highest tier.

zh.headline: 運輸署料開學日交通較繁忙 緊急中心明早最高級別運作
zh.dek: 署方已提醒鐵路、專營巴士、渡輪及的士提供充足服務，有需要時加密班次；緊急事故交通協調中心明早會以聯合督導模式運作。

en.headline: IVE stages three Hong Kong arena nights from Friday
en.dek: The South Korean group's Show What I Am world tour plays AsiaWorld-Arena on 4, 5 and 6 September, with an 8pm start on Friday and 6pm on the weekend.

zh.headline: IVE香港站周五起一連三場亞博Arena
zh.dek: 韓國組合IVE世界巡演《SHOW WHAT I AM》定於9月4至6日在亞洲國際博覽館Arena舉行，周五晚上8時、周末晚上6時開場。

en.headline: Think tank says more than a quarter of students want sports careers
en.dek: Our Hong Kong Foundation surveyed about 1,100 secondary pupils and called for dual-track school guidelines and clearer entry routes into the industry.

zh.headline: 團結香港基金：逾四分一中學生有意投身體育行業
zh.dek: 基金會訪問約1,100名中學生，指近半人不清楚入行途徑，建議為全港中學編制雙軌發展指引。

en.headline: Coleman Wong exits US Open after first-round loss to Tommy Paul
en.dek: The Hong Kong qualifier took the opening set in a tie-break on Louis Armstrong Stadium, then dropped the next three against the 20th seed.

zh.headline: 黃澤林美網男單首圈不敵保羅 先贏一盤後遭逆轉
zh.dek: 港將在路易斯阿姆斯壯球場搶七先下一城，其後連輸三盤，以盤數1比3止步20號種子。

en.headline: Observatory may issue Standby Signal as Saudel remnant rebuilds
en.dek: A special weather hint at 8.20am said the remnant of Tropical Cyclone Saudel may strengthen into a tropical depression near Hainan this evening.

zh.headline: 沙德爾殘餘料增強 天文台考慮黃昏前後發一號波
zh.dek: 天文台今早8時20分發特別天氣提示，指沙德爾殘餘黃昏前後移向海南島東南沿岸，並逐漸增強為熱帶低氣壓。

en.headline: Tai Kwun to present Anne Imhof’s first major Asia solo show
en.dek: House of Swans opens on 25 September at JC Contemporary and runs until 3 January, with opening-week performances involving Hong Kong Ballet.

zh.headline: 大館下月舉行Anne Imhof亞洲首個大型個展
zh.dek: 《House of Swans》9月25日至明年1月3日於JC當代空間展出，開幕周有香港茵蕾舞團參與演出。

en.headline: Driver arrested for drink-driving after Kwun Tong roundabout crash
en.dek: A motorcyclist was injured when a private car hit a motorcycle at the Lei Yue Mun Road and Kai Tin Road roundabout late on Sunday.

zh.headline: 觀塘迴旋處私家車撞電單車 司機涉酒駕被捕
zh.dek: 週日近午夜，鯉魚門道與啟田道交界迴旋處兩車相撞，電單車司機手腳受傷送院，私家車司機酒精測試超標。

en.headline: Police record 2,020 messaging hijack cases in seven months
en.dek: Instant-messaging account takeovers rose 154 per cent from January to July, police said, with WhatsApp involved in 99 per cent of cases.

zh.headline: 首7個月通訊軟件騎劫案升154% 99%涉WhatsApp
zh.dek: 警方錄得2,020宗即時通訊帳戶騎劫案，按年升一倍半，損失約1.5億元，當中絕大部分發生在WhatsApp。

en.headline: Barminski cardboard airport show runs at JPS Gallery until 19 September
en.dek: Runway 51 turns the Staunton Street gallery into a life-size cardboard terminal; admission is free, and the space is open Tuesday to Saturday.

zh.headline: Barminski紙皮機場展於中環JPS畫廊展至9月19日
zh.dek: 《51號跑道》把士丹頓街畫廊改成一比一紙皮航廈，免費入場，開放時間為周二至六上午11時至晚上7時。

en.headline: Canada's Hong Kong PR pathways close to new applications today
en.dek: Ottawa will stop taking new Stream A and Stream B filings after 31 August; applications already received will still be processed, Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada said.

zh.headline: 加拿大港人永久居留途徑今日截止接受新申請
zh.dek: 移民部確認Stream A及Stream B於8月31日停止收新表，限期或之前遞交的申請會繼續審理；截至6月底約1.3萬人已取得永久居民身分。

en.headline: Ex-Wang Fuk Court committee member charged over loan scheme
en.dek: Kong Cheung-fat, 64, and his wife Cheung Yeuk-lan, 62, face two fraud counts and one money-laundering count over the 100 per cent guarantee loan scheme, police said.

zh.headline: 宏福苑前法團委員江祥發夫婦被控詐騙及洗黑錢
zh.dek: 64歲江祥發及62歲妻子張若蘭被控兩項詐騙及一項洗黑錢罪，案件周二在沙田裁判法院提堂，涉百分百擔保特惠貸款。

en.headline: Tourist video shows taxi fare jump after Disneyland trip
en.dek: A passenger said a meter reading of about HK$144.50 from Disneyland to Tsuen Wan West became HK$376 after the driver cited a bridge fee; Lantau Link tolls have been waived since 2020.

zh.headline: 遊客指迪士尼的士以過橋費將車資加至376元
zh.dek: 短片顯示由樂園往荃灣西如心酒店，咪錶約144.5元後司機稱要過橋費，最終收376元；青嶼幹線已於2020年底起豁免收費。

en.headline: Hikers filmed trying to ride a resting cow at Ma On Shan
en.dek: A video circulating on Sunday showed a woman attempting to straddle cattle at Ngong Ping before a passer-by shouted at her to stop.

zh.headline: 馬鞍山昂平行山客試圖騎牛打卡 遭途人喝止
zh.dek: 周日流傳片段顯示女子在昂平多次嘗試跨上伏地黃牛，旁人喝止後兩人離開。

en.headline: Police smash hotel SIM-box phone-scam den, arrest two men
en.dek: Commercial Crime Bureau officers linked a rented hotel room to at least five late-August cases involving about HK$600,000, the largest a HK$380,000 loss by a retiree.

zh.headline: 警搗酒店「貓池」電騙中心拘兩男 涉款約60萬
zh.dek: 商業罪案調查科指酒店房間興8月下旬最少5宗電話騙案有關，最大一宗退休人士損失約38萬元。

en.headline: CHP warns influenza may stay active as school year begins
en.dek: Eleven severe paediatric flu cases have been recorded since late June, including one death; the centre expects outbreaks may occur after students return.

zh.headline: 防護中心料開學初期流感仍活躍 籲學校家長防疫
zh.dek: 今季自6月底起已錄11宗兒童流感嚴重個案，包括一宗死亡；中心料想新學年學校或現爆發。

en.headline: Theme park performer Bernice Yuen crowned Miss Hong Kong 2026
en.dek: The 26-year-old Baptist University graduate won Sunday night’s final at TVB City, with Ada Tang and Scarlett Li named first and second runners-up.

zh.headline: 主題樂園演員袁絲珩奪2026香港小姐冠軍
zh.dek: 26歲浸大傳理畢業生周日晚於將軍澳電視城勝出港姐決賽，鄧匡閵及李澤欣分獲亞軍及季軍。

en.headline: Hung Shui Kiu pilot project to create over 6,000 jobs, Paul Chan says
en.dek: The Financial Secretary said the consortium awarded the large-scale land disposal site will invest about HK$16.8 billion, marking a milestone for the public-private partnership model in the Northern Metropolis.

zh.headline: 陳茂波：洪水橋先導項目料創造逾6,000職位
zh.dek: 財爺指獲批大面積土地處置先導區的財團將投資約168億元，標誌北部都會區公私營合作新模式的里程碑。

en.headline: Mother of late singer Anita Mui dies aged 102 in Causeway Bay
en.dek: Tam Mei-kam collapsed while being fed liquid oatmeal at her Leighton Road flat on Sunday morning and was later certified dead at Ruttonjee Hospital.

zh.headline: 梅艷芳母親覃美金銅鑼灣寓所離世 享年102歲
zh.dek: 周日早上在禮頓道單位進食流質食物時暈倒，送往律敦治醫院後證實不治，警方指現場無可疑。

en.headline: AFCD to prosecute three owners for failing to leash large dogs
en.dek: During Sunday patrols in Yuen Long, West Kowloon, Cyberport and Kai Tak, officers found three people suspected of not properly controlling large dogs in public; further checks continue next weekend.

zh.headline: 漁護署巡查將檢控三狗主 涉公眾地方未用狗帶牽引大狗
zh.dek: 周日在元朗、西九、數碼港及啟德一帶巡查，發現三名畜養人涉嫌未妥善控制大型狗隻，署方將提出檢控，下周末行動繼續。

en.headline: Wang Fuk Court acceptance climbs to 97.7 per cent ahead of deadline
en.dek: As of noon on Sunday 1,939 of 1,984 owners had returned acceptance letters, leaving about 45 households; the Housing Bureau urged the remainder to act by 5pm Monday.

zh.headline: 宏福苑業主接受收購比率升至97.7% 尚餘約45戶
zh.dek: 截至周日中午，1,984戶中有1,939戶已交回接受書，房屋局呼籲餘下業主於周一傍晚5時前把握最後機會。

en.headline: Police arrest 321 in two-month anti-drug operation, seize HK$130m drugs
en.dek: Operation Defender from mid-July to late August netted 234 cases and more than 230 kg of suspected narcotics, including a marked rise in etomidate products, police said.

zh.headline: 警方暑假反毒行動拘321人 檢值1.3億元毒品
zh.dek: 代號「捍衛者」行動由7月中至8月底進行，偵破234宗案件，檢獲逾230公斤懷疑毒品，依托咪酯相關產品數量明顯上升。

en.headline: Work-week outlook: showers and storms early, then easing
en.dek: The Observatory expects mainly cloudy conditions with showers and squally thunderstorms on Monday and Tuesday, becoming windier midweek before rain eases later in the week.

zh.headline: 工作周天氣展望：初段有驟雨雷暴 後期雨勢減弱
zh.dek: 天文台預料周一及周二大致多雲，有驟雨及狂風雷暴，中期風力較大，本周後期雨勢逐漸減弱。

en.headline: Police investigate video of dog put in running washing machine
en.dek: Mong Kok officers are examining a circulated Instagram story that appears to show a live dog tumbling inside a front-loading machine with water flowing; no arrest has been made.

zh.headline: 影片疑將狗放入洗衣機開動 警列求警調查
zh.dek: 社交平台流傳Instagram限時動態，疑有人將活狗放入滾筒洗衣機並開機，旺角警區動物專隊正跟進，暫未有人被捕。

en.headline: Observatory extends Thunderstorm Warning until 3pm
en.dek: The warning first issued at 9.40am was prolonged again after isolated thunderstorms continued to be forecast over Hong Kong, the Observatory said.

zh.headline: 天文台將雷暴警告延長至下午3時
zh.dek: 天文台上午9時40分發出的雷暴警告再延長至下午3時，預料本港有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: AFCD takes eight-year-old dog identified as a pit bull mix
en.dek: Officers collected the dog on Friday after a complaint; the department said the owner produced no valid fighting-dog licence.

zh.headline: 漁護署帶走八歲黑狗 獸醫鑑定屬比特鬥牛㹴混種
zh.dek: 署方周五接投訴後將狗隻帶回動物管理中心，指畜養人未能出示有效格鬥狗隻牌照。

en.headline: Observatory extends Thunderstorm Warning until 1pm
en.dek: The warning issued at 9.40am was prolonged after isolated thunderstorms were forecast over Hong Kong, the Observatory said.

zh.headline: 天文台將雷暴警告延長至下午1時
zh.dek: 天文台上午9時40分發出的雷暴警告已延長至下午1時，預料本港有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: Ocean Park Halloween Fest returns from 5 September
en.dek: The park lists its 2026 Halloween Fest on the official programme, with haunted houses and an Under the Castle collaboration running into early November on designated dates.

zh.headline: 海洋公園萬聖節活動9月5日起舉行
zh.dek: 公園官方節目及門票頁列出2026年萬聖節活動，指定日期設鬼屋及《Under the Castle》合作體驗，活動描述為舉行至11月1日。

en.headline: Porsche on test plates catches fire on Tai Hang Road
en.dek: The driver stopped and left the car after smoke rose from the rear near Tiger Balm Garden; firefighters put out the blaze and nobody was hurt.

zh.headline: 大坑道T牌保時捷行駛中起火 無人受傷
zh.dek: 一輛掛紅色試車牌的保時捷週日早上在大坑道近虎豹別墅車尾冒煙起火，司機停車逃生，消防救熄，無人受傷。

en.headline: Tin Shui Wai man arrested after early-morning public fight
en.dek: Police said a 32-year-old man was taken to hospital unconscious after a clash near a Tin Heng Estate playground, then arrested on suspicion of fighting in a public place.

zh.headline: 天水圍天恒邭凌晨鬥鬥 32歲男昏迷送院後被捕
zh.dek: 警方接報一名男子在天恒邭遊樂場附近遭至少四名男子圍毆，頭部受傷昏迷送院，其後涉嫌在公眾地方鬥鬥被捕。

en.headline: Observatory issues Thunderstorm Warning until 11.30am
en.dek: Isolated thunderstorms are expected over Hong Kong's eastern waters after the warning was issued at 9.40am, the Hong Kong Observatory said.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告 有效至上午11時半
zh.dek: 天文台上午9時40分發出雷暴警告，預料本港東部水域有局部地區雷暴，警告有效至上午11時30分。

en.headline: Harbour City Toy Story carnival enters its last two days
en.dek: FOREVER TOYS at the Tsim Sha Tsui complex, built around Toy Story 5, is scheduled to end on Monday after a summer run that began in June.

zh.headline: 海港城《反斗奇兵》嘉年華進入最後兩日
zh.dek: 以《反斗奇兵5》為題的FOREVER TOYS活動由6月舉行至周一結束，海運大廈及港威商場仍設打卡裝置及主題店。

en.headline: Motorist stops missing six-year-old boy outside Yuen Long Plaza
en.dek: Police said a passer-by reported the child wandering near Castle Peak Road on Saturday afternoon; he was unhurt and returned to his mother.

zh.headline: 元朗廣場外發現報失六歲男童 途人報案助團聚
zh.dek: 警方指周六下午有途人在青山公路元朗段近元朗廣場發現男童獨自徘徊，事主沒有受傷，其後交還45歲母親照顧。

en.headline: Three private cars collide on Cheung Tsing Highway; nobody hurt
en.dek: The three vehicles piled up near the airport spur on Saturday night and stopped in the fast lane; all three male drivers passed breath tests, police said.

zh.headline: 長青公路三私家車串燒相撞 無人受傷
zh.dek: 三車周六晚近十時在往新界方向近機場支路相撞後停在快線，三名男司機通過酒精呼氣測試，警方正調查起因。

en.headline: Chiikawa-themed Light Rail makes its last weekend trips today
en.dek: Special trains have run four trips each Saturday and Sunday from Siu Hong since 25 July; an $88 same-day Light Rail pass is sold at that stop.

zh.headline: Chiikawa主題輕鐵今日最後一個周末行走
zh.dek: 由7月25日起逢周六日由兆康開出四班特色列車，當日於該站可買88元全日輕鐵乘車證。

en.headline: Discovery Bay stages fourth open-water swim challenge today
en.dek: Solo races of 400 metres, 1.7 kilometres and 3.8 kilometres, plus a 400-metre relay, finish at Tai Pak Beach on Sunday.

zh.headline: 第四屆愉景灣公開水域泳賽今日舉行
zh.dek: 公開組設400米、1.7公里及3.8公里個人賽，另有400米接力，終點同為大白灣泳灘。

en.headline: Driver missing after private car hits railings in Sau Mau Ping
en.dek: Police found an empty white private car with a damaged front end at On Sau Road and On Kin Road shortly after 5am and are trying to contact the owner.

zh.headline: 秀茂坪私家車撞欄司機不知所終
zh.dek: 周日清晨一輛白色私家車在安秀道轉入安健道時撞向路中鐵欄，警員到場發現車內無人，正聯絡車主。

en.headline: Fairview Park house burgled; jewellery worth about $300,000 taken
en.dek: A 49-year-old man reported two rings and a jade bracelet missing from a detached house on Bauhinia South Road late on Saturday; police classified the case as burglary.

zh.headline: 元朗錦緣花園獨立屋遇竊 失約30萬元戒指玉鑛
zh.dek: 一名49歲男子周六深夜報稱紫荊南路獨立屋失竊，警方初步點算兩隻戒指及一隻玉鑛失蹤，暫未有人被捕。

en.headline: Hong Kong Fashion Fest returns from 1 to 14 September
en.dek: The government-backed third edition will stage eight flagship programmes across the city, with public exhibitions free of charge.

zh.headline: 第三屆香港時裝蕃九月1日至14日舉行
zh.dek: 政府主辦的時裝蕃將推出八大旗艦節目，公眾展覽免費入場，涉及西九、會展及市區快閃店。

en.headline: MTR halts Tung Chung East works after new brick wall toppled
en.dek: A worker pushing a loaded pallet jack knocked down a wall started that afternoon, sending bricks to a lower floor; nobody was hurt, the corporation said.

zh.headline: 東涌東站磚牆被喊車撞倒 港鐵暫停涉事範圍工程
zh.dek: 港鐵表示，承建商指星期六下午4時許工人推載料喊車時疑撞倒剛開始硬建的磚牆，部分磚頭掉至下層，事件無人受傷。

en.headline: CFS recalls Taiwan rice noodles after trace formaldehyde found
en.dek: A Hsin Tung Yang sample bought from an online shop contained 12 parts per million of formaldehyde, the Centre for Food Safety said.

zh.headline: 台灣新東陽新竹米粉驗出微量甲醛 食安中心召回
zh.dek: 食物安全中心表示，網店抽查的新東陽新竹米粉樣本含百萬分之十二甲醛，已指示分銷商停售及回收受影響批次。

en.headline: Tai Po Baptist Public School opens new Fu Shin Estate campus
en.dek: Nearly 600 pupils displaced after the Wang Fuk Court fire reunite at renovated premises after months at two temporary sites; Education Secretary Christine Choi officiated at the opening.

zh.headline: 大埔浸信會公立學校富善邨新校舍啟用
zh.dek: 宏福苑火災後近600名師生分散兩處臨時校舍數月，周六於富善邨新校舍重聚，教育局局長蔡若蓮主持開幕。

en.headline: AFCD launches special dog-control patrols with immediate enforcement
en.dek: Special inspections begin today and continue on 5 and 6 September at places where dogs gather; owners who fail to keep dogs properly controlled will face action without prior warning.

zh.headline: 漁護署今起特別巡查狗隻控制 違例即時執法不預警
zh.dek: 署方今日及9月5、6日在全港多個狗隻聚集地點加強巡查，若發現畜養人未妥善控制狗隻將即時執法，不會事先警告。

en.headline: Diocesan Boys’ School to offer three university pathways from 2027
en.dek: The elite Direct Subsidy Scheme school plans to add the International Advanced Level curriculum alongside the DSE and IB Diploma, pending Education Bureau approval.

zh.headline: 拔萃男書院擬2027年起開辦三條升學路徑
zh.dek: 直資名校計劃新增國際高級程度會考課程，與文憑試及國際文憑並行，成為本港首間提供三條升學途徑的學校，尚待教育局批准。

en.headline: Man arrested after laundry pods dumped in Kam Ying Court turtle pond
en.dek: Police detained a 42-year-old man on suspicion of cruelty to animals after chemical laundry pods caused one fish to die and injured more than 30 turtles at the Ma On Shan estate.

zh.headline: 錦英苑龜池遭投洗衣球 警拘42歲男涉殘酷對待動物
zh.dek: 馬鞍山錦英苑二期水池周三發現大量泡沫，一魚死亡、逾30隻龜灼傷，沙田警區刑事調查隊周五以涉嫌殘酷對待動物拘捕一名42歲男子。

en.headline: City Chamber Orchestra stages Space Fantasy family shows this weekend
en.dek: Three English-language performances run at Tsuen Wan Town Hall on Saturday and Sunday, combining live music, dance, theatre and circus for ages three and up.

zh.headline: 城市室樂團《太空幻遊》本周末荃灣大會堂上演
zh.dek: 周六下午3時及晚上7時半、周日下午3時於荃灣大會堂演奏廳演出，英語家庭節目，門票120元起。

en.headline: CHP investigates new local Mpox case involving 39-year-old man
en.dek: The patient is stable and will continue isolation at Princess Margaret Hospital; high-risk groups are urged to get vaccinated.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查39歲男子猴痘確診個案
zh.dek: 患者情況穩定，將轉送瑪嘉烈醫院繼續隔離治療；中心呼籲高風險群組接種疫苗。

en.headline: Hong Kong earmarks HK$50 million for Nepal-Tibet mudslide victims
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee said the Disaster Relief Fund Advisory Committee will handle applications swiftly after deadly flash floods along the Himalayan border.

zh.headline: 李家超：賑災基金預留5,000萬元支援尼中泥石流災區
zh.dek: 行政長官對遇難者表示沉痛哀悼，賑災基金諮詢委員會將迅速處理撥款申請。

en.headline: Huanggang Port 20,000-person drill runs smoothly, ID or home-return permit accepted
en.dek: Security Secretary Chris Tang said the final large-scale pressure test with Shenzhen went as planned and opening timing will be decided jointly once conditions are met.

zh.headline: 皇崗口岸兩萬人演練大致暢順 開通後可用身分證或回鄉證
zh.dek: 保安局局長鄧炳強表示今次為開通前最後一次大型動員演練，整體暢順有序，正式通關時間將與深方協商決定。

en.headline: San Tin Tech City land prices ‘negotiable’, chairman seeks chip and drone firms
en.dek: Sunny Chai said the 210-hectare site will focus on mid- and downstream advanced manufacturing and that the company has already approached one or two leading enterprises.

zh.headline: 查毅超：新田科技城地價有得傾 已接觸一兩間龍頭企業
zh.dek: 新田科技城公司主席指園區集中中下游先進製造，冀吸引芯片、無人機及新能源車等高新產業落戶。

en.headline: Hospital Authority clarifies $250 diabetes fee is for personalised treatment
en.dek: The authority said the charge is not an admission fee for a talk but covers clinical assessment, personalised dietary advice and follow-up under the gazetted fee schedule.

zh.headline: 醫管局澄清糖尿病250元屬個人化治療收費 非講座入場費
zh.dek: 局方指收費按政府憲報標準，涵蓋臨床評估、個人化飲食建議及跟進，絕大部分一般健康教育講座均免費。

en.headline: Education chief says textbook prices up 3.6 per cent, rejects universal grant
en.dek: Christine Choi said the bureau is monitoring costs and has told publishers to avoid excessive packaging, while targeted subsidies remain available for low-income families.

zh.headline: 蔡若蓮：教科書價升3.6% 關注價格問題 拒恢復通派津貼
zh.dek: 教育局局長表示局方密切監察書價，已要求出版商避免過度精美印刷，基層家庭繼續獲書簿津貼。

en.headline: Palace Museum Egypt exhibition closes on Monday
en.dek: Ancient Egypt Unveiled at the Hong Kong Palace Museum ends on 31 August after a nine-and-a-half-month run in West Kowloon.

zh.headline: 香港故宮古埃及展周一結束
zh.dek: 香港故宮文化博物館「古埃及文明大展──埃及博物館珍藏」將於8月31日結束，西九展覽已舉行約九個半月。

en.headline: Fosun files Hong Kong listing for Club Med lifestyle group
en.dek: The mainland owner of Club Med said its ClubMed Lifestyle Group has applied to list on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Main Board.

zh.headline: 復星為Club Med生活集團申請在港上市
zh.dek: 復星國際公布，旗下ClubMed Lifestyle Group已向香港聯交所提交主板獨立上市申請。

en.headline: Ride-hailing platform licence applications open until 30 October
en.dek: The Transport Department is inviting platform companies to apply for licences, while the transport minister said approvals will be decided on merit and not by a set number of operators.

zh.headline: 網約車平台牌照開放申請 截止10月30日
zh.dek: 運輸署邀請平台公司申請網約車服務牌照，運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示會擇優而取，暫不預測會批出多少個牌照。

en.headline: Labour Department issues Amber Heat Stress at Work Warning
en.dek: The Labour Department said some workplaces face fairly high heat stress after issuing an Amber warning at 9.50am, and told employers to take heat-stroke precautions.

zh.headline: 勞工處發出黃色工作暑熱警告
zh.dek: 勞工處今早時9時50分發出黃色工作暑熱警告，指部分工作環境熱壓力頗高，提醒僱主及僱員採取防暑措施。

en.headline: DoJ welcomes NPCSC amendments regularising GBA lawyers scheme
en.dek: Amendments to the mainland Lawyers Law take effect on 1 September, giving dual-qualified Hong Kong lawyers a statutory basis to practise specified matters in nine Guangdong cities.

zh.headline: 律政司歡迎全國人大常委會修訂律師法 規範大灣區律師機制
zh.dek: 內地《律師法》修訂將於9月1日生效，為具備雙重資格的香港律師在廣東九市執業指定民商事法律事務提供法律依據。

en.headline: Tin Sum police station to become reporting centre from Sunday
en.dek: After the Tin Sum Division is merged into Sha Tin and Ma On Shan divisions, the Hin Keng Street report room will operate as a reporting centre from 8am to 10.30pm daily.

zh.headline: 田心警署周日改為報案中心 服務至晚上10時半
zh.dek: 沙田警區田心分區周日併入沙田及馬鞍山分區後，顯徑街報案室將改為報案中心，每日上午8時至晚上10時半開放。

en.headline: Observatory issues Very Hot Weather Warning on Saturday morning
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 8.40am, expecting very hot weather today with a high of about 33 degrees and brief sunshine after early showers.

zh.headline: 天文台周六早上發出酷熱天氣警告
zh.dek: 天文台今早8時40分發出酷熱天氣警告，預料今日酷熱，最高氣溫約33度，早上有驟雨後日間短暫有陽光。

en.headline: LCSD dance bills by local choreographers go on sale 1 September
en.dek: Three new works by Kaki Lee, Ching Chu and Rosalie Ng will play in Kwai Tsing and Tai Po this autumn and winter under the Hong Kong Artists Series 2026.

zh.headline: 康文署香港藝術家系列三齣新舞作 9月1日開售
zh.dek: 李嘉禊、朱晴及伍家蔚新作將於今秋至冬季在葵青劇院及大埔文娛中心黑盒劇場上演，早鳥優惠至9月14日。

en.headline: Government tenders Jardine's Lookout site for EV fast charging
en.dek: Inland Lot No. 9105 at 137 Tai Hang Road, covering 901.3 square metres, is being sold for conversion into an electric-vehicle fast charging station, with tenders closing on 6 November.

zh.headline: 政府招標出售渣甸山地皮作電動車高速充電站
zh.dek: 大坑道137號內地段第9105號面積901.3平方米，指定改作電動車高速充電站，公開招標於11月6日截標。

en.headline: Healthcare centre launches online medical dispute platform
en.dek: The Healthcare Dispute Resolution Centre opened a virtual and in-person mediation and arbitration service on Friday for patients and providers in Hong Kong and the Greater Bay Area.

zh.headline: 醫療爭議解決中心推出網上調解平台
zh.dek: 非牟利機構周五啟用網上及面對面調解與仲裁服務，供本港及大灣區患者與醫療服務提供者處理爭議。

en.headline: EDB opens Primary One 2027 applications from mid-September
en.dek: Hong Kong children born on or before 31 December 2021 can join the Primary One Admission System for September 2027, with digital applications encouraged through the ePOA platform.

zh.headline: 教育局公布2027年小一入學安排 9月中起接受申請
zh.dek: 2021年12月31日或之前出生、未曾入讀小學亦未獲派小一學位的本港兒童，可參加2027年9月小一入學統籌辦法，當局鼓勵經電子平台申請。

en.headline: Sui and Tang attire exhibition opens at Central Library
en.dek: Free show at Hong Kong Central Library runs until 6 September, blending reconstructed historical clothing with contemporary fashion and digital displays.

zh.headline: 隋唐服飾展於中央圖書館舉行 免費入場至9月6日
zh.dek: 中國文化節活動於香港中央圖書館展覽廊展出復原古裝、當代時裝及數碼展示，融合歷史與現代設計。
